quote.text: The greatest education in the world is watching the masters at work.You coudn't teach a person what I've learned just standing and watching. Some musicians - Springsteen and U2, for example - may feell they got their education from the streets. I'm a performer at heart. I got mine from the stage.

"If the others heard me talking out loud they would think that I am crazy," he said loud. "But since I am not crazy, I do not care. And the rich have radios to talk to them in their boats and to bring them the baseball."
